COD.rationale: Content (red coordinates), an organizational pattern (coordinate block), and a separate origin/status field present for the same referent/time.

C.rationale: Multiple explicit content entries identify represented contents with attributes (red/blue) and coordinates.

D.rationale: For the same referent the report supplies content coordinates and separate origin/status metadata, distinguishing content from its record/status.

O.rationale: The text states display orientation and shows explicit coordinate-grouping for a referent, indicating how content is organized/presented.
